notes:
ONE-TIME SETUP (read before importing)

1. Import this file into n8n (Workflows > Import from File).

2. This workflow receives an inbound webhook from Calendly, so n8n must be reachable from the public internet at the time a booking happens (same requirement as the score-tracker's inbound Twilio SMS webhook, see score-tracker/README.md — use ngrok or a real public domain, not localhost).

3. Register the Calendly webhook subscription by running scripts/register_calendly_webhook.py once (needs CALENDLY_API_KEY and CALENDLY_USER_URI already in .env, plus your public n8n URL). This tells Calendly to POST here whenever someone books.

4. Confirm credentials 'Gmail - cham4547@gmail.com' and 'Twilio account' are already connected in n8n (both are reused from other workflows in this repo).

5. UNVERIFIED: the Parse Booking node's field mapping is based on Calendly's documented v2 webhook schema but has not been tested against a real booking. After the first real (or Calendly's own test-ping) booking comes in, check this workflow's execution log in n8n and confirm firstName/email/startTimeCentral/location came through correctly — adjust the Parse Booking code if Calendly's actual payload differs.

6. Run manually first with a test execution if possible, then toggle Active ON.
